The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `piVar3` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom raw-offset struct copy (4 consecutive `*(T *)(base + 0xNN) = *(T *)(base + 0xNN);` lines copying a contiguous block). Ghidra lost the struct type; replace the run with a struct assignment or `memcpy(...)` in a .keep (find/create the matching struct type for the block).

Inlined fast sqrt bit-trick (bias `_DAT_01d1a0a4`). Ghidra's numeric `(int)` cast is wrong; the asm reinterprets the float's bit pattern. Bias `_DAT_01d1a0a4` is not a known magic - this may be a sibling-program variant. Confirm against the .asm (SAR/ADD on the float's bits), then express it via a bit-cast helper in a .keep; no named helper is guaranteed to exist in this program.
